# Koded Labs

> Independent product studio building from Lagos, Nigeria.
> Founded and operated by Raufu Abdulrahman Ayobami (Koded).

## About

Koded Labs is a lean, independent software studio that ships real products.
We focus on the gap between what exists and what should — building tools for
developers, workers, and infrastructure that doesn't yet exist in our markets.
Every product starts with a problem worth solving and ends with something
people can actually use.

Principles: small by design, focused by necessity, serious about craft.

## Products

- **Scafld** — The complete backend lifecycle platform. From idea to deployed
  API without switching tools. Status: Live.
  URL: https://scafld.kodedlabs.com

- **Recivo** — WAEC for the informal economy. A voice-and-simulation skill exam
  that turns a trader's hands into a verifiable credential. Status: Live.
  URL: https://recivo.vercel.app

- **EV Hacks** — Nigeria's EV intelligence layer. Find where to build EV
  charging infrastructure or where to charge your vehicle. Status: Live.
  URL: https://ev-hacks.vercel.app

- **Stackd** — Coming soon.

## Founder

- **Koded** (Abdulrahman Ayobami) — Founder, Engineer, Builder.
  Handles product, engineering, and strategy across everything the lab ships.
  Origin: Lagos, Nigeria.
